name: WF-259 — Negotiation Decision → Revised Offer / Contract Decision

parameters.jsCode: const d=$json.body??$json;const lead_id=d.lead_id??null,deal_id=d.deal_id??null,property_id=d.property_id??null;const decision=String(d.negotiation_decision??"").toLowerCase();const counter=Number(d.counteroffer_amount??NaN);const mao=Number(d.dynamic_mao??d.adjusted_mao??NaN);const offer=Number(d.offer_price??NaN);let action="needs_review",reason="Negotiation outcome requires review.",next="WF-126";if(!lead_id||!deal_id||!property_id){action="blocked";reason="Missing lead, deal, or property identity.";}else if(["acceptance_ready","counteroffer_within_mao"].includes(decision)){const accepted=decision==="acceptance_ready"?(Number.isFinite(offer)?offer:counter):(Number.isFinite(counter)?counter:NaN);if(!Number.isFinite(accepted)||!Number.isFinite(mao)){action="evidence_required";reason="Accepted price and dynamic MAO are required.";next="WF-258";}else if(accepted>mao){action="maO_guardrail_failed";reason="Accepted price exceeds dynamic MAO.";next="WF-258";}else{action="contract_decision_ready";reason="Price is within dynamic MAO and ready for contract decision.";next="WF-260";}}else if(decision==="counteroffer_near_mao"){action="revised_offer";reason="Counteroffer is near MAO; revised offer requires human approval.";next="WF-260";}else if(decision==="counteroffer_above_mao"){action="walk_away_or_revised_offer";reason="Counteroffer exceeds dynamic MAO; human negotiation decision required.";next="WF-126";}else if(["rejection_reengagement","clarification_follow_up","follow_up_needed"].includes(decision)){action="reengagement";reason="Seller requires follow-up before contract decision.";next="WF-260";}else{action="needs_review";next="WF-126";}return[{json:{workflow:"WF-259",lead_id,deal_id,property_id,negotiation_decision:decision,counteroffer_amount:Number.isFinite(counter)?counter:null,dynamic_mao:Number.isFinite(mao)?mao:null,offer_price:Number.isFinite(offer)?offer:null,negotiation_action:action,reason,requires_human_review:action!=="contract_decision_ready",next_workflow:next,guardrails:{dynamic_mao_primary:true,accepted_price_must_not_exceed_mao:true,rule_70_percent:"secondary_reference_only"}}}];
